card.name: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki
card.typeLine: Enchantment — Saga // Enchantment Creature — Goblin Shaman

template.name: Mana Dork or Mana Dork Creator

variants.easyPrerequisites: Reflection of Kiki-Jiki does not have summoning sickness.
variants.description:
Activate the mana dork by tapping it, adding one mana.
Activate Reflection of Kiki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant with haste.
Declare the token Combat Celebrant as an attacker and exert it, untapping all creatures you control and gaining an extra combat.
Repeat.

card.name: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki
card.typeLine: Enchantment — Saga // Enchantment Creature — Goblin Shaman

variants.easyPrerequisites: Reflection of Kiki-Jiki does not have summoning sickness.
variants.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block at least one creature you control.
variants.description:
Activate Reflection of KIki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant with haste.
Declare the Combat Celebrant token and, if needed, an additional creature an opponent cannot block as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
When you attack, the token Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When you deal combat damage, Grim Hireling triggers, creating at least one Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Repeat.

variants.easyPrerequisites: Reflection of Kiki-Jiki does not have summoning sickness.
variants.notablePrerequisites: Tanuki Transplanter or the creature it is attached to can attack without taking damage.
variants.description:
Activate Reflection of KIki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant with haste.
Declare Tanuki Transplanter and Combat Celebrant token as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
When you attack, Tanuki Transplanter and the Combat Celebrant token trigger.
Resolve the token's trigger, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve Tanuki Transplanter's trigger, adding mana.
Repeat.
